name: KENT Maxx Plus
summary: KENT Maxx Alkaline-B in an attractive black colour is a next-gen UV water purifier that not only provides purified water through purification process of UV+UF+Alkaline but also enhances the pH levels of the purified water up to 9.5. This purifier comes with a transparent detachable storage tank for easy cleaning.
intro: The KENT MAXX Alkaline-B Water Purifier is a wall-mounted, UV-based water purifier designed for tap and municipal water supplies. It features a multi-stage purification process with alkaline enhancement to provide safe, clean, and better-tasting drinking water. Its compact ABS food-grade plastic body and 7-litre storage tank make it suitable for homes and small offices.
features: Multi-stage purification with Sediment, Carbon Block, UF, Post Carbon & Alkaline filters
UV purification with 11W UV lamp for effective disinfection
Alkaline technology to enhance water quality
High purification capacity of up to 20 L/hr
Ideal for tap and municipal water supply
